learning_outcomes.text: Know the architecture of internal combustion engines and their thermodynamic cycles
Know engine testing methods and their laboratory application for experimental analysis to evaluate state variables and characteristic curves.
Be able to work in a team, apply critical reasoning, make decisions, and communicate knowledge and conclusions in the field of industrial engineering.

teaching_methods: Classroom presentation of concepts and problem-solving, group discussion sessions
Personal study, report writing, practical exercises as independent work
assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated as: 0.45 * Exam 1 + 0.45 * Exam 2 + 0.1 * Laboratory Practices. The continuous assessment process consists of two partial exams and two laboratory practices, for which reports must be submitted. Failure to complete practices or submit reports results in a 0 for laboratory practices. In ordinary and extraordinary calls, partial exam grades are not carried over, and the student must retake the entire course. Only the laboratory practice grade is saved if passed.
